862-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

789-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

512-4091-7203.easyPrerequisites: Brigid and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
512-4091-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures
512-4091-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Brigid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4091-7203.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Brigid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-1981-2415-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
728-1981-2415-4446.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5256-6026.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-851-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

969-1563-2457-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

372-2493-7431.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Daydream exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2493-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Daydream.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6607-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4659-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4659-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

372-2921-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-1526-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
1379-1526-1978.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

3054-3416-5670-6578.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-6578.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
3054-3416-5670-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

431-3129-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-3129-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2428-3591-6282.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one more card in hand than your maximum hand size.
2428-3591-6282.description:
Proceed to your cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Necropotence triggers for each card discarded.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Discard cards down until your maximum hand size, as the cleanup step is still onging.
Repeat from step 2.

539-2034-3534-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
539-2034-3534-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ashaya, adding {C}{C}.
When Ashaya dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Ashaya enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control a nontoken creature that has haste, you may instead sacrifice it, and then tap it each iteration to get infinite green mana and colorless mana.

1447-1734-5231.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

488-874-2478-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
One of either Delif's Cone or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-2478-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

204-1251-1858-2056-2633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1251-1858-2056-2633.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

774-2653-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

586-2393-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Sifter of Skulls and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

678-2060-2123-4017-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
678-2060-2123-4017-5256.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Kokusho's power.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

692-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
692-2034-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Wildwood Mentor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos.

439-2713-3458-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding {R/G}.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Impromptu Raid by paying {R/G}, revealing Arashin Sovereign from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1391-1636-4576.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional green or white creature, as well as one additional creature.
1391-1636-4576.description:
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by tapping Fallaji Wayfarer, a green or white creature, and one additional creature.
Fleetfoot Panther enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Fleetfoot Panther trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2584-3356.description:
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
When Polyraptor enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 5 damage to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor dies as a state-based action due to lethal damage.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat from step 2 using the new Polyraptor token instead.

2034-2781-3582-4871.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's loyalty abilities have not been used this turn.
2034-2781-3582-4871.description:
Activate Kaya's +1 loyalty ability to put a Ghostform Counter on Felidar Guardian.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {W}.
Sacrifice the Spirit token for {C}{C}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {1}.
Cast Felidar Guardian for {1}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Kaya and return her to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1283-1309-1518-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1283-1309-1518-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

628-2899-4929.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite for X = 0 by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite dies due to having zero toughness.
Cryptic Trilobite's undying ability from Mikaeus triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing the +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on activated abilities.
Repeat from step 2.
